# For the tests: no GPU, no PyTorch, no model. They run on the fictional
# calls in examples/ with the server started --no-model.
#
#     pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
#     pytest tests/test_engine.py tests/test_api.py
#
# The page tests also need a browser:
#
#     pip install playwright && playwright install chromium
#     pytest tests/test_page.py
